headline: Markets closed for weekend; Kirloskar firms secure ₹366 crore pumps order

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian stock exchanges are closed today owing to the weekend.
Trading activity will resume in the next scheduled session on Wednesday, 25 November.
Corporate actions and order wins reported over the weekend remain in focus for upcoming sessions.
Personal finance updates regarding EPFO calculators and pay commission recommendations were highlighted.
whatHappening: Kirloskar group firms secured an order worth ₹366 crore for supplying pumps to a Nigerian refinery.
Kavya Maran gifted gold rings, chocolates, and wedding invites to Sun Group employees.
Pune FDA suspended licences of 17 establishments including The Fern, Hotel Orchid in Lonavala, and Burger Barn Cafe.
Unions under the 8th Pay Commission demanded capping promotion waiting times to 4 years instead of 12 years.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November. Key news flow includes Kirloskar firms bagging a ₹366 crore order from a Nigerian refinery. Attention also remains on corporate gifts at Sun Group and regulatory actions by Pune FDA.
